listing.name: WWE All Stars (WWE All Stars Recomp)
listing.summary: A WWE All Stars Windows x64 Vulkan port with project-reported matches, controls and shader preparation. The ZIP includes the player and initial setup launcher: import and check your own USA/Europe Xbox 360 ISO and supported TU2, prepare shaders/pipelines, then use game/wweallstars.exe. Release notifications check for new versions but do not download them. Source development separately uses VS2026/ReXGlue; framework portability does not establish other players. Complete-game, multiplayer, exact accepted input hashes and BIOS/firmware requirements are unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
